notes.title: Open Episodes Extended!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/132/781.jpg[/img]

[UPDATE] Heroes and villains, we're EXTENDING the Open Episodes period through January 31, 2017! Start the new year right and celebrate the sixth anniversary of DCUO by completing some of your favorite storylines!

[u][b]What are Open Episodes?[/b][/u] From November 21 – January 31, 2017, you’ll be able to play through the content in Episodes 1 - 26 with your fellow heroes (or villains!), regardless of if you’re a member or have previously purchased the episode content.

That means that through January, you can experience [b]ALL the storylines[/b] in DCUO. Whether there’s something new you wish to discover or an old favorite you want to return to, you’ll have access to the content across almost every episode in DCUO. What mysteries await you in The Bombshells Paradox? Do you have what it takes to battle for earth against Brainiac? Will you take time to chill out in the Icerberg Lounge? There are all sorts of places to explore and iconic characters to match wits with during this Open Episode period!

Grab your friends and celebrate the new year with Open Episodes!

[b]FAQ:[/b]

[b]What about Episode 27: Amazon Fury Part III?[/b] 
Only Episodes 1-26 are included in Open Episodes. Our newest episode, Episode 27: Amazon Fury Part III, will not be open to all players; you’ll need to be a member or purchase the episode in order to access that content.

[b]What about the loot lockouts?[/b]
Members and/or those who have purchased the episode(s) will have the standard loot lockout times. Those who are not members and have not purchased the episode(s) will have longer loot lockout times.

[b]What do I need to access the Episodes?[/b]
Episode content requires a minimum combat rating of 43; you must have the minimum CR required by each episode to play the specific episode content. You must have DC Universe Online on PC in order to play the game and access add-on episode content.

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Season's Greedings Returns!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/131/131021/35521.jpg[/img]

[h1]Season's Greedings![/h1]

Larfleeze is back! Find and recover the stolen gifts in Metropolis and Gotham City before it's too late! Look for “Yuletide Fear” (Villains) or “Winter Plunderland” (Heroes) in your Mission Journal. Players must be at least level 10 to participate.

Larfleeze’s greed can’t be satisfied so he is taking advantage of a heated battle between the Green Lanterns and the Sinestro Corps. Look for “Ring in the Holidays” in your Mission Journal. Players must complete “Yuletide Fear” or “Winter Plunderland” and “Season’s Greedings” in order to receive the “Ring in the Holidays” Daily Mission. Each day of the event, look for “Season’s Greedings” and “Ring in the Holidays” in your Mission Journal to complete the mission and earn Holly Leaves.

notes.title: Free Play Month+! Open Episodes Return Through 2016!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/129/581.jpg[/img]

Heroes and villains, we’re thankful for you and the impact you’ve had on the world of DC Universe. To show our appreciation, we’re bringing back [b]Open Episodes[/b] from now through the end of 2016!

[u][b]What are Open Episodes?[/b][/u] From November 21 – December 31, 2016, you’ll be able to play through the content in Episodes 1 - 26 with your fellow heroes (or villains!), regardless of if you’re a member or have previously purchased the episode content.

That means that through the end of the year, you can experience [b]ALL the storylines[/b] in DCUO. Whether there’s something new you wish to discover or an old favorite you want to return to, you’ll have access to the content across almost every episode in DCUO. What mysteries await you in The Bombshells Paradox? Do you have what it takes to battle for earth against Brainiac? Will you take time to chill out in the Icerberg Lounge? There are all sorts of places to explore and iconic characters to match wits with during this Open Episode period!

Grab your friends and celebrate the end of 2016 with Open Episodes!

[b]FAQ:[/b]

[b]What about Episode 27: Amazon Fury Part III?[/b] 
Only Epsiodes 1-26 are included in Open Episodes. Our newest episode, Episode 27: Amazon Fury Part III, will not be open to all players; you’ll need to be a member or purchase the episode in order to access that content.

[b]What about the loot lockouts?[/b]
Members and/or those who have purchased the episode(s) will have the standard loot lockout times. Those who are not members and have not purchased the episode(s) will have longer loot lockout times.

[b]What do I need to access the Episodes?[/b]
Episode content requires a minimum combat rating of 43; you must have the minimum CR required by each episode to play the specific episode content. You must have DC Universe Online on PC, PSN, or Xbox One in order to play the game and access add-on episode content.

notes.title: A Favor from the Gods: Increased Rare Drops!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/128/128341/34121.jpg[/img]

Heroes and Villains. You will soon be called upon to head to Olympus and beyond to challenge the gods and prevent havoc from reaching our mortal realm in [u]Amazon Fury[/u] Part III.

To prepare yourself for what lies ahead, we’ve dialed back the Bad Luck Limiter to [b]TWO[/b] in order to increase the amount of rare drops you’ll receive.

How does that work? In modern content (where both the Loot Selection Window and Bad Luck Limiter are implemented), if you are not offered a rare drop on either of the first two bosses, you will be on the third. In other words, since modern content has three bosses, you will be [u]sure[/u] to get a rare drop from each piece of content that you fully complete.

The event will run from [b]5:00 AM PST[/b] on [b]Friday, November 11[/b], 2016 through [b]5:00 AM PST[/b] on [b]Monday, November 14[/b], 2016.

The gods await you in [u]Amazon Fury[/u] Part III. Do not miss your chance to be prepared to face them head on!

notes.title: Stabilizer Sale! Plus, Halloween Costume Contest and Sale!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/126/901.jpg[/img]

Thanks to Booster Gold, Time Capsules have been sent through the Multiverse and have been arriving in DCUO’s here-and-now since late August. If you’ve kept these safely stowed away unopened, or if you’re anticipating more coming your way soon ([u]and since they drop in regular gameplay, that’s going to happen[/u]!), you’ll want to pay attention to this sale!

From [b]Friday, October 21, 2016[/b] through [b]Monday, October 24, 2016[/b], Stabilizers – which are required in order to open up a Time Capsule – are on sale in the Marketplace for [b]20% Off[/b]! This means a Stabilizer will cost just [b]80 MC/DBC[/b] and a pack of 20 Stabilizers will cost just [b]1,520 MC/DBC[/b].

So hurry to the Marketplace for Stabilizers before the sale ends!

New to Time Capsules? Want more details on how they work and what they include? [b][url=https://www.dcuniverseonline.com/guides/time-capsules-items-keys-how-to-dcuo-2016]Visit our Guides section[/url][/b].

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/126/921.jpg[/img]

Have you been encountering a number of haunts on the streets of Gotham City? What sort of horrors have you seen in the Midnight Masquerade Nightclub? [b]The Witching Hour[/b], [url=https://www.dcuniverseonline.com/news/gu64-witching-hour-aura-pack-ii-dcuo-2016]DCUO’s Fall Seasonal Event[/url], is only here through [b]Monday, October 31[/b], and to add on to the frighteningly fun festivities, we have two [b]MORE[/b] things coming:

[h1]STYLE ITEM SALE[/h1]

Still stressing over your perfect costume? Set your fears aside, because from [b]Friday, October 21, 2016[/b] through [b]Monday, October 31, 2016[/b], most style items in the Marketplace will be [b]ON SALE[/b] for 25% off! There’s still plenty of time to get your hands on the perfect look for less for your hero or villain.

[h1]COSTUME CONTEST[/h1]

Once you’ve got your costume all figured out, enter our [b]DCUO Costume Contest[/b]! Dress your in-game character in your best Witching Hour-themed costume, snap a screenshot, and see if you win! Entries will be accepted from 12:00PM (Noon) Pacific on [b]Friday, October 21, 2016[/b] through 12:00PM (Noon) Pacific on [b]Friday, October 28, 2016[/b]. You can enter by uploading your image to [url=http://daybreakgames.votigo.com/fbcontests/profiletab/DCUO-Costume-Contest-The-Witching-Hour-2016]our contest site[/url] or by following & tweeting to [url=https://twitter.com/dcuo]@DCUO[/url] using the hashtag #DCUOCostumeContest.

Once the entry submission period ends, it’s time to [b]VOTE[/b]! Visit the contest site to vote for your favorite entries between 12:00PM (Noon) Pacific on [b]Friday, October 28, 2016[/b] through 12:00PM (Noon) Pacific on [b]Monday, October 31, 2016[/b]. You may vote once per entry per day. The top vote getters will move on to the judging phase!

Can your spooky style impress our judging panel? Top vote getters from the Costume Contest will be evaluated by a panel of judges who will pick [b]SIX (6) WINNERS[/b] based on Creativity, Originality, and Theme. The winners will each receive [b]one Stabilizer[/b] and their choice of [u]either[/u] [b]Aura Pack II[/b] or 1500 Daybreak Cash/Loyalty Points.

For full rules and to enter or vote, [url=http://daybreakgames.votigo.com/fbcontests/profiletab/DCUO-Costume-Contest-The-Witching-Hour-2016]visit the DCUO Costume Contest site here[/url].

notes.title: Available Now: Game Update 64!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/124/124341/32961.jpg[/img]

Game Update 64 is now available, and it brings with it two potentially terrifying events if you don’t have your wits about you.

[h1]The Witching Hour[/h1]

The Witching Hour, DCUO’s Fall Seasonal Event, has returned once again! It’s up to you, heroes and villains, to head to the streets of Gotham City and inside the Midnight Masquerade Nightclub and see if you can get a handle on the horrors that are haunting it. Heroes, you’ll look for the [b]Phantom Stranger[/b] inside the [b]East End Safehouse[/b]; villains, find [b]Tala[/b] inside [b]The Tap Room in Burnley[/b]. They will have further instructions for you!

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/124/662.jpg[/img]

Each day of the event, look for The Witching Hour in your Mission Journal; complete the mission and earn Spooky Bites, which can be used in Skeets’ Boo-tique for the latest in scare-wear, tricks, treats, and creepy items for your Base or League Hall. To queue for The Midnight Masquerade, go to your On Duty UI and look under the Events tab. The mission and the event are available to players at or above Level 10.

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/124/682.jpg[/img]

If you want to stock up on the latest items but don’t have quite enough Spooky Bites, visit the Marketplace! [url=https://www.dcuniverseonline.com/news/aura-pack-ii-dcuo-2016]Spooky Bites can now be purchased[/url] and then used in game at Skeets’ Boo-tique.

And don’t forget to visit The Vault during The Witching Hour. It’s a bit spookier in there than you’re used to!

In 2016, The Witching Hour brings with it new Base Items, Feats, and Styles! If you get any for your character, make sure you share screenshots with us on Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/dcuo]@DCUO[/url]) or [url=https://forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php]on the forums[/url]!

[h1]Survival Mode: Oan Sciencells[/h1]

You have faced the worst of the universe before, but not like this! With the return of Survival Mode: Oan Sciencells, you’ll be faced with stronger foes and increased challenges. Queue up and see how long you can last against unending waves of the slew of universal criminals threatening to escape. Players can queue up for Survival: Oan Sciencells in the Event tab (if they meet the CR requirement).

With GU64, Survival Mode: Oan Sciencells will feature new Exo Pants and Custom Exo Back for rounds 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10!

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/124/683.jpg[/img]

Requirements: 8 Players, Minimum CR 173 (175 Recommended).

[h1]Aura Pack II + Spooky Bites[/h1]

New Vapor Aura variants and Spooky Bites (seasonal currency) are now available in the Marketplace! [url=https://www.dcuniverseonline.com/news/aura-pack-ii-dcuo-2016]Visit this article for all the details[/url]!

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/124/741.jpg[/img]

[h1]Want More?[/h1]

The full patch notes for GU64 are [url=https://www.dcuniverseonline.com/update-notes/dcuo-game-update-64]available here[/url].

notes.title: Celebrate Batman Day with DCUO!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/123/581.jpg[/img]

Saturday, September 17, 2016 is an auspicious day in this part of Gotham City ([u]and the whole DC Universe[/u]). [url=http://www.dccomics.com/blog/2016/09/01/about-batman-day-2016]It’s Batman Day[/url]! Batman appears in many forms in DCUO; revisit [url=https://www.dcuniverseonline.com/news/dcuo-batman-day-2015]our feature from last year[/url] to see him in his many in-game forms.

This year, in honor of the truly legendary Dark Knight, we have some special happenings inside DCUO! But rather than limit them to a single day, they’ll be occurring for nearly an entire [b]week[/b] – from [b]Thursday, September 15[/b] through [b]Wednesday, September 21, 2016[/b].

[h1][b]Legends PvE Week[/b][/h1]

Batman is the quintessential Legend. So this week [b]all[/b] Legends PvE events are open for [b]all[/b] players! Ready to head to the South Gotham Courthouse? Think you have what it takes to tackle Area 51? Will the Hall of Doom or the Paradox Wave prove to be your undoing? There are [b]twelve events[/b] in total that you can attempt during the Legends PvE Week, from [b]September 15[/b] through [b]September 21, 2016[/b]!

[h1][b]Marketplace Sale[/b][/h1]

In addition to the Legends event, if you head to the Marketplace you’ll find that Exobyte Data for [b]all[/b] Legends characters are on sale for [b]40% off[/b]! Ever wanted to experience Legends content as Future Batman? Maybe Bombshell Catwoman? Or Arkham Asylum Joker? These and more will be available during our weeklong sale.

And if that weren’t enough, we’re also marking Batman-related items in the Marketplace down 40% as well! This includes base items ([u]like the Batcomputer & More Pack[/u]), style items ([u]such as the Batman Cowl Pack[/u]), toys ([u]the Batman bouncy ball![/u]) and more. Get Caped Crusader style and decorate your personal Batcave to match, all at a great discount.

[h1][b]Trivia Sweepstakes[/b][/h1]

We’ll have news about this ON Batman Day, September 17. Check the [url=https://forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php]DCUO forums[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/dcuo]follow @DCUO on Twitter[/url] to see the details and to enter!

Now, it’s time to be the hero (or villain) that DCUO deserves. Head in game and start celebrating Batman Day in Gotham City and beyond!

 
The event and sale begin in the US with daily server restarts at 4AM PT on September 15, 2016, and end at 4AM PT on September 22, 2016. The event and sale begin in the EU with daily server restarts at 8PM PT on September 14, 2016, and end at 8PM PT on September 21, 2016.

This year, in honor of the truly legendary Dark Knight, we have some special happenings inside DCUO! But rather than limit them to a single day, they’ll be occurring for nearly an entire [b]week[/b] – from [b]Thursday, September 15[/b] through [b]Wednesday, September 21, 2016[/b].

[h1][b]Legends PvE Week[/b][/h1]

Batman is the quintessential Legend. So this week [b]all[/b] Legends PvE events are open for [b]all[/b] players! Ready to head to the South Gotham Courthouse? Think you have what it takes to tackle Area 51? Will the Hall of Doom or the Paradox Wave prove to be your undoing? There are [b]twelve events[/b] in total that you can attempt during the Legends PvE Week, from [b]September 15[/b] through [b]September 21, 2016[/b]!

[h1][b]Marketplace Sale[/b][/h1]

In addition to the Legends event, if you head to the Marketplace you’ll find that Exobyte Data for [b]all[/b] Legends characters are on sale for [b]40% off[/b]! Ever wanted to experience Legends content as Future Batman? Maybe Bombshell Catwoman? Or Arkham Asylum Joker? These and more will be available during our weeklong sale.

And if that weren’t enough, we’re also marking Batman-related items in the Marketplace down 40% as well! This includes base items ([u]like the Batcomputer & More Pack[/u]), style items ([u]such as the Batman Cowl Pack[/u]), toys ([u]the Batman bouncy ball![/u]) and more. Get Caped Crusader style and decorate your personal Batcave to match, all at a great discount.

[h1][b]Trivia Sweepstakes[/b][/h1]

We’ll have news about this ON Batman Day, September 17. Check the [url=https://forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php]DCUO forums[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/dcuo]follow @DCUO on Twitter[/url] to see the details and to enter!

Now, it’s time to be the hero (or villain) that DCUO deserves. Head in game and start celebrating Batman Day in Gotham City and beyond!

 
The event and sale begin in the US with daily server restarts at 4AM PT on September 15, 2016, and end at 4AM PT on September 22, 2016. The event and sale begin in the EU with daily server restarts at 8PM PT on September 14, 2016, and end at 8PM PT on September 21, 2016.

notes.title: Available Now: Time Capsules and Game Update 63!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/121/361.jpg[/img]

As you may have heard, Booster Gold has been filling up [b]Time Capsules[/b] with lots of useful and exciting items to send through the Multiverse to you! These have now begun appearing in game with [b][u]Game Update 63. [/u][/b]But how do you find them? How can you open them? What’s waiting for you when you do? Let’s take a few minutes to prepare for their arrival and find out…

[h1]HOW TO OBTAIN A TIME CAPSULE:[/h1]

[b]Time Capsules[/b] can be obtained through regular gameplay. You don’t need to do anything special in order to get these. As you’re playing the game as you normally would, you will eventually find a capsule waiting for you when you defeat an enemy.

[h1]HOW TO OPEN A TIME CAPSULE:[/h1]

To open a capsule, you’ll need a [b]Stabilizer.[/b] There are two ways to obtain a stabilizer: purchasing one from the Marketplace for 100 Daybreak Cash (PC) or Marketplace Cash (Console), or putting one together through gameplay.

When you purchase a whole Stabilizer from the Marketplace, you can use it right away to open your capsule.

In game, you’ll need to find [b]Stabilizer Fragments.[/b] You can use these fragments to piece together a full stabilizer, which can open a capsule. Stabilizer Fragments can currently be earned in-game in the new Duo Event, “[b]Suicide Squad Training.[/b]” Head to Belle Reve to fight against guards, and possibly come face-to-face with a member of the Suicide Squad! You can find this in your On Duty menu under the “[b]Events[/b]” tab.

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/120/761.jpg[/img]

Suicide Squad Training can be completed once per account per day. Free players will receive 3 Stabilizer Fragments per event, Premium players will receive 4 Stabilizer Fragments per event, and Members will receive 6 Stabilizer Fragments per event. It will take 15 Stabilizer Fragments to build a complete Stabilizer. Stabilizer Fragments and Stabilizers are special types of currency that are shared by all characters on your account.

Once you use a stabilizer to open a capsule, you’ll see what sort of goodies Booster Gold has sent to you!

[h1]WHAT IS INSIDE A TIME CAPSULE:[/h1]

Each capsule is tradable and once opened will include a variety of useful, mostly tradable, items. Some of these items will be included inside a [b]separate[/b] capsule or box inside the Time Capsule. These contain styles, auras, collections, and gear, including:

[h1]Future Crusader’s Gear[/h1]

Get one of these boxes in your Time Capsules and you’ll find it contains Future Batman-inspired gear that is level-appropriate to your character. There are different boxes for different item types, including Head, Shoulders, Back, Chest, Waist, Hands, Legs, or Boots.

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/120/741.jpg[/img]

These boxes are tradable until they’re consumed; then, since the gear becomes attuned to your current character’s role and level, they will be locked to that character.

[h1]Lantern Corps Emblems[/h1]

Show your support of the Lantern Corps with these new Emblems! There is an emblem available for every Corps:

[list][*]Black Lantern Corps[/*][*]White Lantern Corps[/*][*]Orange Lantern Corps[/*][*]Red Lantern Corps[/*][*]Blue Lantern Corps[/*][*]Green Lantern Corps[/*][*]Indigo Tribe[/*][*]Sinestro Corps[/*][*]Star Sapphire Corps[/*][/list]

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/120/722.jpg[/img]

[u]In addition to adding flair to your in-game appearance, each Emblem grants a feat, as does collecting them all![/u]

[h1]Misted Auras[/h1]

When you collect certain items from the capsules, they will go towards completing a collection that rewards you with a misted aura – Green, Amber, or Red!

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/120/721.jpg[/img]

Think any of your Lantern Corps-inspired characters could use one of these?

[h1]AND MORE![/h1]

New stat/ability mods, Exobytes, R&D materials, other styles, and additional helpful items will also be found in the capsules. To hear additional information about these new Time Capsules, and to see some of the style items in action, rewatch this livestream replay from July 2016:

https://youtu.be/QfdS8kmCNS4

Time Capsules are now available with the launch of Game Update 63! Stay tuned to the [url=https://forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php]official forums[/url] and DCUO Social Channels ([url=https://twitter.com/dcuo]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/DCUniverseOnline/]Facebook[/url]) for more information!

notes.title: The #SummerOfWonder Sale and More!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/120/781.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]#SummerOfWonder Sale![/h1][/b]

You’ve spent the summer saving the world from Brainiac and various other foes, and now it’s time to take that saving to the [b]Marketplace[/b]. From Thursday, August 18 through Sunday, August 21, enjoy HUGE savings (up to 75% off) most in-game marketplace items in the #SummerofWonder Sale! Powers, Power Respec Tokens, many Styles, and yes, even [b]Replay Badges[/b] are included.

Remember, Sunday, August 21 is not only the last day of the sale – it’s also the last day of Open Episodes [b]AND[/b] the last day to get the Wonder Woman Emblem. Make sure you log in, play, and save THIS weekend before the festivities end. For details on these, visit our [url=https://www.dcuniverseonline.com/news/dcuo-game-update-62-summer-of-wonder-emblems-episodes-2016]Summer of Wonder article[/url].

 
Sale ends at 11:59PM PT on August 21, 2016.  


[b][h1]You're Looking Radiant: Aura Pack I![/h1][/b]

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/119/119781/32122.jpg[/img]

A puff of smoke. A radiant light. A shimmering visage. Whatever your hero or villain’s style, there’s likely an aura to suit them in the new [b]Aura Pack I[/b], now available in the Marketplace!

These never-before-released color variants of the Nimbus, Plasmic, Smoke, and Radiant auras are claimable on every character on your account, and these [b]exact four auras[/b] are in [u][b]every[/b][/u] pack. For a single purchase, you get:
[list][*]Purple Nimbus Aura[/*][*]White Radiant Aura[/*][*]Dark Blue Smoke Aura[/*][*]Purple Plasmic Aura[/*][/list]

Let’s repeat that:
This one purchase gets you these four auras on all of your characters.

The new [b]Aura Pack I[/b] is available now in the Marketplace for 1500 Daybreak Cash.


[b][h1]Look Like You Belong on Themyscira: Amazon Hairstyle Pack[/h1][/b]

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/120/120461/32222.jpg[/img]

Do you remember the first time you came face to face with the Themysciran warriors in Amazon Fury Part I? In addition to being impressed by their fierce strength and their mighty prowess… be honest, how jealous were you of their amazing hair?

If you were, be jealous no more! [b]Three[/b] new Amazonian hairstyles are now available in the DCUO Marketplace in the [b]Amazon Hairstyle Pack[/b]. The bundle (which includes all three styles - Warrior Braid, Fighter's Faux Hawk, and Themysciran Edge) is available for [b]500 Daybreak Cash[/b].

And while the island of Themyscira is inhabited by women only, these styles can be used by both male and female characters!

Switching up your character’s look with one of these new styles? Tweet to [url=http://www.twitter.com/DCUO]@DCUO[/url] and use the hashtag [b]#SummerOfWonder[/b]!

 

[u]Note: These items are redeemable for every character on the account, and they are not tradable. [/u]

notes.title: Suicide Squad Comes to DCUO! Plus, Bonus PvP Weekend!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/119/642.jpg[/img]

Not all heroes are good. Not all villains are bad. And there’s no group where this is truer than in the Suicide Squad. This summer, it’s good to be bad in DCUO. Here are the latest Suicide Squad-themed additions, available now!

[h1]New PvP Gear: Deadshot![/h1]

Do you have enviable aim? Show everyone that they don’t want to get caught in your crosshairs with styles inspired by Deadshot. With these new styles, players can now unlock a more powerful set of PvP gear, after obtaining all previous sets.

[h1]New 4v4 PvP Map: Belle Reve![/h1]

In Amanda Waller’s pursuit to find Heroes and Villains to fill her Suicide Squad ranks, she is sending authorities into Gotham City to arrest people and pitting them against each other. Harley Quinn, under Waller’s watchful eye, has been ‘detained and delegated’ to manage the ‘interviews’ of Belle Reve’s newest inmates as they battle for survival and supremacy. Match up against the best of the best and find out if you’re Squad-worthy in our new Arena and Legends Deathmatch map: Belle Reve!

[h1]DC Bombshells Harley Quinn Styles![/h1]
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/119/641.jpg[/img]

Ready to rev up your look? Dress like the pin-up who packs a punch with styles inspired by DC Bombshells Harley Quinn! This style pack, available now in the Marketplace, includes six style items (the DC Bombshell Harley Belt, Shoes, Goggles, Gloves, Shorts, and Chest).

[u]NOTE: the DC Bombshells Harley hairstyle is sold separately, in the DC Bombshells Hairstyle Pack[/u].

[h1]Bonus PvP Weekend![/h1]
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/119/601.jpg[/img]

Make the most of this Suicide Squad weekend in Belle Reve with DOUBLE the rewards in PvP. Players will receive double the usual Marks of Valor and Marks of Legend when completing any PvP match this weekend (Arenas and Legends). The bonus marks begin today, August 4, 2016, at 10AM PT, and end on Monday, August 8, 2016, at 10AM PT.

 

Questions? Comments? [url=https://forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php?threads/suicide-squad-comes-to-dcuo.277724/]Join the discussion on the official DCUO forums![/url]

notes.title: Episode 26 Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/118/721.jpg[/img]

[h1]Episode 26 Now Available For All Players![/h1]
 

Episode 26 features the ultimate caper with Harley Quinn as the girls head into Wayne Manor to kidnap Bruce Wayne. Plus, the fates of worlds hang in the balance as the Kryptonian storyline concludes in the bottle city of Kandor. Members automatically have access to the new Episode, and non-members can now purchase the new Episode in the Marketplace. 

[b]New Duo: Wayne Manor Gala[/b]

Bruce Wayne and his philanthropic guests are raising funds for the victims of the Brainiac Invasion at Wayne Manor tonight. Rumor has it something sinister is going to go down at the Gala. Many heroes are expected to be in attendance which means mayhem will find this opportunity hard to pass up. Blend in and dance the night away in the new Duo: Wayne Manor Gala! Gain access to new feats, collections and gear! Free to access for Members!

• To play this 2-player Duo, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 162.
• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Duo under Tier 8 of the 2-Player Tab.

[b]New 8-Player Raid: Kandor Central Tower[/b]

Using stolen technology, General Zod has restored Kandor to its normal size! Still trapped within Brainiac’s bottle, Kandor now resides in the Arctic near the Fortress of Solitude. While its unknown whether Kandor on its own is a threat to Humanity, there is no doubt that Zod intends to raise an army of Kryptonians and rule the planet. Join Superman, Superboy, and Supergirl in Kandor to convince everyone that Humans and Kryptonians can share the planet and live in peace in the new 8-Player Raid: Kandor Central Tower! Gain access to new feats, collections and gear! Free to access for Members!

• To play this 8-player Raid, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 162.
• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Raid under Tier 8 of the 8-Player Tab.

Questions? Comments? [url=https://forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php?threads/play-episode-26-now.277403/]Join the discussion with your comments on the official forum![/url]

notes.title: Welcome to the Summer of Wonder with Game Update 62!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/117/117781/31642.jpg[/img]

This summer in DCUO is about to get hotter than ever. Welcome to the [b]#SummerOfWonder[/b]! Beginning today (Wednesday, July 20), we have amazing stuff happening: open episodes, a FREE Wonder Woman emblem, and an awesome RT to share sweepstakes! Before we get into all the details, now’s a perfect time to make sure you’re following us on [b][url=https://twitter.com/dcuo]Twitter[/url],[/b] [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/DCUniverseOnline/]Facebook[/url][/b], and [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/dcuniverseonline]Twitch[/url],[/b] so you don’t miss a second of the action.

To truly kick off our [b]#SummerOfWonder[/b], in honor of Wonder Woman’s 75th Anniversary, watch this video:

https://youtu.be/0pjki7p4Vho

What else is happening as part of the Summer of Wonder? Well…

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/117/782.jpg[/img]
[h1]OPEN EPISODES[/h1]
From July 20 – August 21, 2016, [u]all[/u]* DCUO players will be able to experience the content available in [b]Episodes[/b]! Whether or not you’re a member, or whether or not you’ve bought the episode, for about one month you’ll be able to play through the content with your fellow heroes (or villains!).

Will you take this opportunity to take on Trigon? Are Batman and Lex Luthor waiting for you in Origin Crisis? In honor of Wonder Woman’s 75th Anniversary, is it time to go through Amazon Fury Part I and II? Learn more about [url=https://www.dcuniverseonline.com/shop/episodes]all of the Episodes available here[/url].

[u][b]What about the loot lockouts?[/b][/u] 
Members and/or those who have purchased the episode(s) will have the standard loot lockout times. Those who are not members and have not purchased the episode(s) will have longer loot lockout times.

 

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/117/784.jpg[/img]
[h1]WONDER WOMAN EMBLEM[/h1]
She’s an Amazon, a leader, a mentor, and she’s celebrating a BIG anniversary this year! Celebrate Wonder Woman and all she stands for with the new Wonder Woman emblem, available for FREE to all who log in between July 20 and August 21, 2016!

As a bonus, when you collect the emblem, you’ll get [b]7.5 Hours[/b] of Double XP!

 

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/117/783.jpg[/img]
[h1]#SUMMEROFWONDER SWEEPSTAKES[/h1]
Want a chance at one of [b]TWENTY[/b] prize packs? Don’t miss our [b]#SummerOfWonder[/b] sweepstakes! We have [b]FIVE[/b] Grand Prize packs and [b]FIFTEEN[/b] Second Place Prize packs to give away. All you need to do is [url=https://twitter.com/dcuo]follow @DCUO[/url] and RT the official sweepstakes tweet and you’ll be entered to win:

[b]GRAND PRIZE (5 Available):[/b]

notes.title: The Tides of War and 4th Color Option Launch with Game Update 61!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/115/461.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Game Update 61![/u][/b]

[b][u]Tides of War Summer Event![/u][/b]

The battle for the throne of Atlantis continues! Ocean Master, Aquaman's conniving half-brother, has rallied a force of mutineer Atlanteans in an attempt to displace King Arthur and take the throne! The Atlantean civil war has breached the waters of Metropolis. Track "Tides of War" in your Mission Journal and check the Events tab in the On Duty menu to battle for the Atlantean Outpost. Fight for your side, and reap new rewards including new feats!

In celebration of our Summer Event this year, we have added new Summer-themed base items, and new Summer-themed styles that will keep you looking snappy when the fight heats up! Level Requirement: 10

 

[u][b]4th Color Option![/b][/u]

With GU 61, we have added a 4th color option for players. This means they now have a choice of 4 colors to assign to their existing 3 color slots, as opposed to only 3 color choices.

 

[u][b]New in the Marketplace: Soder Cola Ultimate 12-Pack![/b][/u]

The exertion of battle got you down? Try the new Soder Cola Ultimate 12-pack! One sip of a Soder Cola Ultimate will restore your health and power to 100%! This special formula also increases your Health, Power, Restoration, Power Heal, Dominance, and Damage by 1% for 30 minutes. Check it out in the Supplies section of the Marketplace!

 

[url=https://forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php?threads/server-hotfix-june-22-2016-game-update-61.275861/]Click here to read the full update notes.[/url]

notes.title: The RPG Scrollbars: Breaking The Superhero Curse
notes.content:
In this era of a hundred comic book movies a year plus spin-off shows, it’s getting harder and harder to remember that not so long ago trying to take a superhero off the printed page and onto some kind of screen was basically a recipe for failure, mockery, and a way of flying a promising creative career into a great big rock. Hell, even now most superheroes without the word ‘Bat’ in their name are still waiting for someone to even attempt a game, never mind make a good one. For every Batman on NES or Arkham Asylum, there’s an Aquaman or Superman on Nintendo 64.

On PC, it’s always been particularly weird. Especially when you look at which companies have tried and failed over the years to bring us the ultimate superhero RPG. Is there anything out there that comes close? Ignoring Freedom Force, since that’s not an RPG? Well, some! Enough not to have to hold out for a hero, at least.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: The RPG Scrollbars: Rise Of The MOBA Heroes
notes.content:
Hello there. This week, I’m writing not just as an RPG columnist, but as president of the newly formed League Of Folks Who Don’t Really Play MOBAs But Are Bizarrely Hooked On All The Trappings. As far as I can tell, our membership is roughly a billion people and counting. That’s what happens when the likes of Blizzard and Riot spend literally tens of dollars creating gorgeous videos to promote their worlds, yes, but it goes somewhat deeper than that. Have you ever watched a new character reveal for a game you know you’re never going to play? Then the sickness might have spread.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Launching Today: Episode 24, Game Update 60, and the Booster Bundle!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/113/221.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Episode 24 Now Available For All Players![/b][/h1]
 
Episode 24 brings Darkseid to DC Universe Online in an explosive conclusion to the Darkseid and New Gods storyline, and begins a new storyline featuring Harley Quinn in a heist in Gotham City. Members automatically have access to the new Episode, and non-members can now purchase the new Episode in the Marketplace. 

[h1][b]Episode 24[/b][/h1]

[b]New 2-Player Operation: The Will of Darkseid[/b]

The war between the New Gods is heating up on New Genesis. Report to the battle site and help defend the area from Darkseid’s invasion force in the new 2-Player Operation: The Will of Darkseid! Gain access to new feats, collections and gear! Free to access for Members!

• To play this 2-player Duo, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 150.
• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Duo under Tier 7 of the 2-Player Tab.


[b]New 8-Player Operation: Brainiac’s Bottle Ship[/b]

Lois may have temporarily halted General Zod from getting the coordinates of Brainiac’s Bottle Ship, but now Zod is holed up in the top room of Lex Luthor’s Science Spire and is threatening to attack the city of Metropolis! Meet with Supergirl find a way to remedy the situation in the new 8-Player Operation: Brainiac’s Bottle Ship! Gain access to new feats, collections and gear! Free to access for Members!

• To play this 8-player Operation, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 150.
• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Operation under Tier 7 of the 8-Player Tab.


[h1][b]Game Update 60[/b][/h1]

[b]Celestial AM Update![/b]

 Improvements have been made to Celestial powers to reduce how often combo powers will be disrupted. Additionally, a 3-second grace period has been added to allow players to get back into the Advanced Mechanic after a disruption. Read the full update notes for details.


[b]Vendor 00 Update![/b]

The style vendor has been updated with style sets from more recent Episodes. This is the vendor that allows players to acquire styles from vendor gear they did not acquire on-level. The styles are only available after they have outleveled the gear. Read the full update notes for details.

 
[h1][b]NEW Booster Bundle, Featuring the Cosmic Material![/b][/h1]

The Booster Bundle is back with a whole new way to customize your character's visual costume: Materials! [url=https://www.dcuniverseonline.com/news/dcuo-booster-bundle-cosmic-material-2016]Learn more about Materials and the new Booster Bundle here.[/url]


Excited about Episode 24, GU60, Materials, and/or the new Booster Bundle? [url=https://forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php?threads/launching-today-episode-24-game-update-60-and-the-booster-bundle.274035/]Join the discussion with your comments on the official forum![/url]

notes.title: Now Available: Batman v Superman Swag Bags! Plus, Game Update 58 and the St. Patrick's Day Event!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/107/842.jpg[/IMG]
 
[h1][B]BvS Swag Bags![/B][/h1]
 
Two new swag bags are now available in the in-game Marketplace, and they are both packed full of BvS goodness inspired by the upcoming film.
 
First, in the BvS Logo Swag Bag, you will find six new emblems based on the costumes for Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman, and a black t-shirt featuring the logo from the movie. Then, in the BvS Poster Swag Bag, take home 20 official movie posters for your in-game base. Get ready for the film today!
 
Items in the Logo Swag Bag are redeemable on all characters on your account. Items in the Poster Swag Bag are redeemable once.

notes.content:

[h1][b]Members Play Episode 22's New Kryptonian Storyline Now![/b][/h1]

Members, your early access to Episode 22 is now available. Become a member today and you can start playing Episode 22 immediately. Episode 22 will also be available for purchase in the Marketplace on March 9, 2016.


[h1][b]Episode 22[/b]
[b]New 4 Player Operation: Phantom Zone[/b][/h1]

The Fortress of Solitude’s defense systems are malfunctioning just as Superman is busy investigating an incredible off world threat. The source appears to be the Phantom Zone Projector! Superman needs trusted heroes to help check out the disturbance!

Meanwhile Lex Luthor, having inserted listening devices in the Fortress during the Fortress raids long ago, is calling on villains to come play while Superman’s away, in the new 4-Player Operation, Phantom Zone! Unlock the Elite Mode, gain access to new feats, collections and gear! Free to access for Members!

• To play this 4-player Alert, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 146.
• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Alert under Tier 7 of the 4-Player Tab.

[h1][b]New Solo: The Science Spire[/b][/h1]

Something went down in the Phantom Zone, and a certain prisoner has escaped, along with his followers. Lois Lane, intrepid reporter, is on the case! Her sources have described sightings of Kryptonians near Lex Luthor’s Science Spire, and she believes they are after information stored there.

Help Lois break in and investigate before she’s the one getting scooped in the new solo, The Science Spire! Gain access to new feats, collections and gear! Free to access for Members!

notes.title: New Episode Inspired By DC's Legends Of Tomorrow! Plus, CROSS PLAY!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/105/223.jpg[/IMG]
 
 
[h1][B]Members Play Episode 21 First![/B][/h1]
 
Members, your early access to Episode 21 is now available. [URL=www.dcuniverseonline.com/shop/membership]Become a member today[/URL] and you can start playing Episode 21 right away! Episode 21 will also be available for purchase in the Marketplace on February 10, 2016.
 
[h1][B]Episode 21
New Duo: The First Piece[/B][/h1]
 
A mysterious figure has asked you to investigate a heist taking place in one of Gotham University’s Museum Warehouses. The target appears to be a valuable and potentially powerful Kahndaqi artifact. Partner with Hawkgirl or Heat Wave to retrieve the artifact and discover who’s behind the heist in the new Duo, The First Piece! Gain access to new feats, collections and gear! Free to access for Members!
 
• To play this 2-player Duo, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 142.
• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Duo under Tier 7 of the 2-Player Tab.

[h1][B]New 8 Player Operation: Prison Break[/B][/h1]
 
The same mysterious contact has asked you to work with the latest member of the team, the Atom! Who is this mysterious person and what are his motives? For now, he has asked his newly formed Team of Legends to break out a recently incarcerated individual from Stryker’s Island! There’s just one catch, he’s being held in maximum security inside the Penitentiary. Hatch a plan with the Atom and break him out from the inside...as inmates in the new Operation, Prison Break! Gain access to new feats, collections and gear! Free to access for Members!
 
• To play this 8-player Operation, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 142.
• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Operation under Tier 7 of the 8-Player Tab.
 
[h1][B]Cross Play Now Available Between PS3, PS4, and PC![/B][/h1]
 
DCUO players on PC and PS now play together with cross play! When you log in today, you will seamlessly be playing with players on the opposite platform, including in groups, in leagues, in On Duty content, and in the open world. We hope you will enjoy the new faces you'll meet, and the freedom to play with virtually anyone or everyone else (in your region) who plays DCUO.
 
In the spirit of togetherness such an occasion calls for, several players are planning a cross play meet up in the Metropolis PvE phase this Friday night. Join us in-game during the [URL=www.twitch.tv/trexlight]DCUO SourceCast[/URL] and get to know some new friends. We'll be there! [URL=forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php?threads/crossplay-meet-and-greet-friday.267139/]Click here for more information.[/URL]
 
[h1][B]Frequently Asked Questions[/B][/h1]
 
[B]Q: What is cross play?[/B]
A: Cross play will allow all players on PC, PS3, and PS4 to play together as if they were on the same servers. In game, the transition will be essentially seamless. The biggest thing you will notice is more players around.
 
[B]Q: Does cross play mean I can play my characters on PC and PS?[/B]
A: No. The accounts remain separate, and your characters remain attached to your PC or PS accounts.
 
[B]Q: Do my purchases transfer to the other platform?[/B]
A: No. The accounts remain separate, and your characters remain attached to your PC or PS accounts.
 
[B]Q: Can I transfer my characters from one platform to another?[/B]
A: No. We do not plan to offer character transfers of any kind, for business and technical reasons.
 
[B]Q: Can we be in groups and leagues together?[/B]
A: Yes, after cross play launches, groups and leagues will both be able to contain a mixture of PC, PS3, and PS4 players.

notes.title: Episode 20 Now Available! Plus, 5th Anniversary Celebrations and News!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/104/101.jpg[/img]


[h1]All Players Can Now Play Episode 20![/h1]

Episode 20 is now available for all players! Members already have access automatically with membership, and non-members can now purchase the Episode in the Marketplace. 

[b]Episode 20
Blackest Night[/b]

And so ends the War of the Light saga, the epic finish to one of DCUO’s most powerful storylines.

A massive Black Lantern has erupted from the blood-soaked streets of war-torn Metropolis and Nekron has risen from this deathly soil. The embodiment of death is no easy foe to defeat and Hal Jordan, Sinestro, and the rest of the champions have been unable to even make a scratch. You must fight alongside Carol Ferris and the Lantern Corps and send Nekron back to the Land of the Unliving in the new Operation, Blackest Night!

• To play this 8-player Operation, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 138.
• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Operation under Tier 7 of the 8-Player Tab.

[b]Wastelands Wonderland[/b]

Imps and demons run amuck in the fiery wasteland, allowing Jacob and Jack to seductively and slowly make their moves. Raven, annoyed as ever by her brothers, has asked for your help in putting them back in their places. Enter the madness and mayhem of the Gotham Wastelands in the new Duo, Wastelands Wonderland!

• To play this 2-player Duo, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 138.
• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new duo under Tier 7 of the 2-Player Tab.


[h1]Happy 5th Anniversary! Plus, News for 2016![/h1]

Happy 5th Anniversary, Heroes and Villains! Today we’re celebrating five years in Metropolis, Gotham, and the many other locations we’ve traveled to in the DC Universe. And we’re just getting started!

To celebrate our anniversary, we were featured on two of Kinda Funny Games’ livestreams today. On Colin & Greg Live, the first big piece of news was announced:

[b]PC/PS Cross-Play[/b]

Have you been waiting to do battle with a friend or family member, but couldn’t because they were playing on a different platform? Get ready to save the world TOGETHER, because PC/PS crossplay is coming the week of January 25, 2016!

Then, on Kinda Funny Plays: DCUO, we revealed a LOT more about what’s coming up in 2016. Watch the replay video for all the action, but here are some quick highlights:

[b]Episode 21: Inspired by the Legends of Tomorrow[/b]

Get ready for Hawkgirl, Hawkman, Captain Cold, and Atom – the Legends of Tomorrow are coming to DCUO in Episode 21 next month.

[b]More New Storylines[/b]

In addition to Legends of Tomorrow-inspired content, you can expect new storylines in 2016 including:

A New Superman Storyline, featuring Zod, Ursa, Non, Superman, Lois Lane, Supergirl, and Superboy, now voiced by Greg Miller! The story will begin in the PhantomZone and will eventually take you all the way to the epic finish in the City of Kandor!

The finale of Halls of Power – Get ready. Darkseid’s forces are invading Central City, and we’re going to need YOUR HELP to stop them!

Harley Quinn – Love Harley Quinn? You will love this crazy storyline centered around her.

Plus, later in the year, the finale of Amazon Fury!


[b]New Powerset: WATER[/b]

Our next powerset is Water, featuring Hydrokinetics (Hard Water Constructs, inspired by characters like Aqualad) and Tide-Calling (Waterbending, inspired by characters like Mera).

[b]4th Color Palette[/b]

Customize your character further with the addition of a 4th choice in your color palette. More colors, more looks, more fun!

[b]Style and Gear Unlocking[/b]

Keep up your alternate characters more easily with style and gear unlocking. Keeping to the philosophy established with unlocking feats, you will be able to unlock gear or styles on one character if you have already earned that style or gear on another.

[b]League Recruitment Tools[/b]

Finding and joining the right League is the absolute best thing anyone can do to enjoy the game to the max, and we’re going to make that easier to do in-game.

[h1]ANNIVERSARY GIFTS![/h1]

You didn’t think we’d forget our anniversary did you? There’s a gift waiting for you to commemorate 2015: a new DC Bombshell poster for your base or league hall PLUS a Daybreak emblem for your character. You have to log in by January 31st to get these items, so don’t wait – log in now!

notes.title: Just Revealed! Episode 20 Will Feature "Blackest Night" and War of the Light Finale!
notes.content:
[i]The Blackest Night falls from the skies,
The darkness grows as all light dies,
We crave your hearts and your demise,
By my black hand, the dead shall rise![/i]

In Episode 20, Nekron has come. He has joined his herald, Black Hand, in extinguishing all light – all life – in the universe. The Metropolis Battlefield was ripe with the lingering death from the War of the Light, allowing Nekron to raise an enormous Black Lantern in the middle of the city. The area around the Lantern is scorched earth, scarred by the Corruption brought by the Black. You must fight alongside the Lantern Corps and send Nekron back to the Land of the Unliving in:

[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/103/221.jpg[/img]


[h1]Blackest Night[/h1]

And so ends the War of the Light saga, the epic finish to one of DCUO’s most powerful storylines.

In this Operation, a Black Lantern has erupted from the blood-soaked streets of war-torn Metropolis and Nekron has risen from this deathly soil. The embodiment of death is no easy foe to defeat and Hal Jordan, Sinestro, and the rest of the champions have been unable to even make a scratch. But don’t worry, the Star Sapphire, Carol Ferris, has a plan. Will you aid her in stopping Nekron and the Black Lanterns from snuffing out all life in the universe?


[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/103/222.jpg[/img]


[h1]Wastelands Wonderland[/h1]

If you need a break from the dramatic ending of the War of the Light, the Gotham Wastelands has plenty of mayhem and madness in store for you. Imps and demons run amuck in the fiery wasteland, allowing Jacob and Jack to seductively and slowly (respectively) make their moves. Raven, annoyed as ever by her brothers, has asked for your help in putting them back in their places.

[h1]Rewards![/h1]

We’re at the final month of this cycle, so it’s time to finish off that set of gear with weapons, rings, necks, trinkets, and a new utility belt. And don’t forget, that weapon is going to drop in a weapon box, giving you the option to choose your weapon...so choose wisely. We’re also dropping a rare, yet incredibly cool iconic style that can be traded or sold on the broker. Oh, and a new OP item too.

And as always, there are new styles, feats, collections, a title, and more!

And so ends the War of the Light saga, the epic finish to one of DCUO’s most powerful storylines.

In this Operation, a Black Lantern has erupted from the blood-soaked streets of war-torn Metropolis and Nekron has risen from this deathly soil. The embodiment of death is no easy foe to defeat and Hal Jordan, Sinestro, and the rest of the champions have been unable to even make a scratch. But don’t worry, the Star Sapphire, Carol Ferris, has a plan. Will you aid her in stopping Nekron and the Black Lanterns from snuffing out all life in the universe?


[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/103/222.jpg[/img]


[h1]Wastelands Wonderland[/h1]

If you need a break from the dramatic ending of the War of the Light, the Gotham Wastelands has plenty of mayhem and madness in store for you. Imps and demons run amuck in the fiery wasteland, allowing Jacob and Jack to seductively and slowly (respectively) make their moves. Raven, annoyed as ever by her brothers, has asked for your help in putting them back in their places.

[h1]Rewards![/h1]

We’re at the final month of this cycle, so it’s time to finish off that set of gear with weapons, rings, necks, trinkets, and a new utility belt. And don’t forget, that weapon is going to drop in a weapon box, giving you the option to choose your weapon...so choose wisely. We’re also dropping a rare, yet incredibly cool iconic style that can be traded or sold on the broker. Oh, and a new OP item too.

And as always, there are new styles, feats, collections, a title, and more!

notes.title: NEW Booster Bundle with Solar Aura AND Batcave Base Item Bundles!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/102/641.jpg[/IMG]

The Marketplace is bursting with so many exciting new items today, it’s hard to decide where to begin. Heroes and Villains alike can join together and rejoice over these incredible new offerings.
 
Let’s kick things off with the latest [B]Booster Bundle[/B] featuring the brand new [B]Solar Aura[/B].
 
[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/102/701.jpg[/IMG]

[B]Booster Bundle[/B]
 
Have you ever wanted to glow brighter than the sun? To show your astronomical power everywhere you walk? You’ll want to try to get your hands on this new Solar Aura, which is one of eight possible auras found in the new Aura Reward Box. In addition to the Solar Aura, there are two new glimmering and five new radiant auras! Here are the eight auras that can be found in the new Aura Reward Box:
 
• Solar Aura
• Orange Glimmering Aura
• Red Glimmering Aura
• Dark Blue Radiant Aura
• Green Radiant Aura
• Red Radiant Aura
• Yellow Radiant Aura
• Light Blue Radiant Aura
 
The Aura Reward Box is just one of the many awesome items included in the Booster Bundle, which is available for [B]1000 Daybreak Cash or Marketplace Cash[/B]. Here’s the full list of what each Booster Bundle includes:
 
• 150 Replay Badges
• 1 Radar Enhancer
• 1 R&D Scanner
• 1 Proto Repair Bot
• 2 Total Recovery Kits
• Bonus: Aura Reward Box
 
This is an AMAZING deal – you pay for the regular Marketplace items and you get the Aura Reward Box as a bonus! Keep the aura for yourself or sell it to others on the Broker! But remember, the Booster Bundle is only available for a limited time!
 
The Booster Bundle will be available from December 3, 2015, to December 16, 2015.
 
 
[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/102/723.jpg[/IMG]
 
But the Booster Bundle isn’t the only newsworthy addition to the Marketplace. Also available are BATCAVE BASE ITEM PACKS!
 
The Batcave is one of the most elusive and iconic locations in the entire DC Universe. It’s been reimagined throughout movies, television series, and, of course, the comics. While this secret location was previously only known and accessed by Batman and his closest allies, now the you, the heroes and villains of DCUO, have the chance to transform your in-game base with the items in the new Batcave Base Item Packs!
 
[B]Pack #1: Batcave Trophies & More Pack[/B]
 
[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/102/722.jpg[/IMG]
 
Who doesn’t want a Batmobile?! Now, granted, you can’t speed through the streets of Gotham with this one, but you can display it proudly alongside many of the other Batcave-inspired items in this pack, including wall and hanging lights, a Batcave door and Bat Symbol window, and large trophy items, like the Joker Playing Card.
 
[B]Pack #2: Batcomputer & More Pack[/B]
 
[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/102/721.jpg[/IMG]
 
If Pack #1 is for the trophy collector, then Pack #2 appeals to the technophile with a replica Batcomputer (in Regular and Alert), computer monitors, and the Bat Symbol Wall Sign. This pack can turn any base into the Tech Hero or Villain’s dream.
 
Of course, if you want the full Batcave experience in your base, you can pick up BOTH packs, now in the Marketplace. Each pack costs [B]400 Daybreak Cash or 400 Marketplace Cash[/B].
 
What are you waiting for? Head to the Marketplace, get your Booster Bundle and Batcave Packs, and get into game! Then, post screenshots of your new auras or decked out lairs below, or tweet them to us at @DCUO!

notes.title: Episode 19 Now Available For Members, Plus Winter Seasonal Event!
notes.content:
[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/101/301.jpg[/IMG]
 
 
[B]Members Can Now Play Episode 19![/B]
 
Members, your early access to Episode 19 begins today!
 
Green Arrow and Captain Cold have both been taken by Ra’s al Ghul and are stowed away in Nanda Parbat. Heroes will fight alongside Black Canary and villains will join forces with Heat Wave in the final chapter of the League of Assassin’s story,[B] “The Demon’s Plan!”[/B] Then, head to the Tunnel of Lust and stop Raven’s brothers from wreaking havoc there, on the Wastelands, and beyond in [B]“Deep Desires.”[/B]
 
[B]The Demon’s Plan[/B] is a 4-Player Alert and [B]Deep Desires[/B] is a 1-Player Solo. Both require your character to be Level 30 with a minimum CR of 134; the suggested CR is 143.
 
[URL='www.dcuniverseonline.com/shop/membership']Become a member today[/URL] and you can start playing Episode 19! Episode 19 will be available for purchase in the Marketplace on December 9th. Watch the trailer now!


[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/102/581.jpg[/IMG]
 
[B]Season's Greedings 2015![/B]
 
It’s beginning to look quite a bit chillier around Metropolis and Gotham, with one small hitch… Larfleeze has returned once again, and is stealing presents! Heroes, search for “Winter Plunderland” in your Mission Journal; villains, you’ll want to find “Yuletide Fear.” Get those presents back where they belong!
 
Once you complete that seasonal task along with “Season’s Greedings,” your assistance will still be needed with the daily mission, “Ring in the Holidays,” where Larfleeze is busy making mischief between the Green Lanterns and the Sinestro Corps. There are two new feats to be earned in this special seasonal content in 2015 – “Who brought the fruitcake?” and “He’s an ANGRY elf.”
 
Heroes and villains, remember, you must be at least Level 10 to participate.
 
[IMG]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/102/561.jpg[/IMG]
 
After you’ve made all things merry and bright, remember to get your holiday shopping done at Skeets’ Workshop! This is where you’ll find the latest winter clothing, holiday goodies, and festive base items. The workshop is accessible from your HQ and inside the Secret Research Facility. Also remember you can pick up some seasonal treats for yourself by running the winter-themed vault! And there are MANY new things you’ll want to get your hands on this year, from a mounted reindeer head to a Gingerbread S.T.A.R. labs base item!
 
You can also find two new winter auras. The Jolly Aura and Snowflake Aura are both available in the Marketplace, and the Jolly Aura also drops in the seasonal content.
 
Enjoy the spirit of the season while it lasts! The event will be in game from Wednesday, December 2, 2015 through Tuesday, January 5, 2016.

notes.title: Now Available: New Atomic Powerset, Episode 18, and Game Update 54!
notes.content:
[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/099/342.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]Members Can Play Episode 18 Now![/b][/h1]

Members' early access to Episode 18 starts now! It's a race against time to save the heroes or villains trapped by the League of Assassins in "The Demon's Pit," and it's a showdown for the ages with Black Hand, herald of Nekron, as the War of the Light nears its conclusion in "Blackest Day."

Subscribe and play today! Episode 18 will launch in the Marketplace on November 11, 2015.


[b]New 2-Player Duo - The Demon's Pit![/b]

The League of Assassin’s sudden interest in Central City has drawn the concern of both the Justice League and the Society. Investigate a final S.O.S. message sent from a scouting mission-gone-wrong deep inside The Demon’s Pit!

To play this 2-player Duo, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 131.

• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Duo under Tier 7 of the 2-Player Tab.
o Minimum CR: 131
o Suggested CR: 138


[b]New 8-Player Operation and Elite Operation – Blackest Day![/b]

The stars grow dim as the Black Lanterns spread across the universe. Black Hand, herald of Nekron, has finally revealed himself by attacking the Sinestro Corps’ sentient city, Ranx, aiming to turn it into a Corruption-spreading machine capable of wiping out the entire Universe! Sinestro conscribes every last one of you to help prevent Ranx from falling into the enemy’s black hand.

To play this 8-player Operation, your character must be level 30 and have a minimum Combat Rating of 131.

• Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Operation under Tier 7 of the 8-Player Tab.
o Minimum CR: 131
o Suggested CR: 138



[img]https://assets-cdn.daybreakgames.com/uploads/dcsclient/000/000/100/802.jpg[/img] 


[h1][b]New Powerset Atomic Now Available![/b][/h1]

Blast your enemies in Tank or Damage roles as the new powerset: Atomic! Members automatically have access to Atomic, and non-Members can find the powerset in the Marketplace today.

Utilize the power of nuclear energy, rearranging the atomic structure of yourself, your allies, and your enemies at will with the Atomic power set! Split Atoms, cause Thermochemical Explosions, and burn under the intense Nuclear Pressure causing unreal destruction. Transmute into fortified metal and reorganize your atomic structure to protect you and your allies in your Tank role, or harness the power of the building blocks of all matter to lay waste to your enemies in the Damage role.

There are two Atomic Power trees:

• Radioactive – Explode with harmful radiation, reducing your enemies to ash and speeding up your recovery with the Radioactive tree.
• Nuclear – Manipulate the subatomic structure of enemies to shield you and your allies with the Nuclear tree.

 

[h1][b]Game Update 54![/b][/h1]

Featuring midrange power updates to Fire, Gadgets, and Quantum, [u][b]the new R&D Gear System[/b][/u], and Cross Faction PvE, Game Update 54 is also available today for all players. 

[url=https://forums.daybreakgames.com/dcuo/index.php?threads/game-update-54-episode-18-atomic-powers.262900/]Continue reading the full update notes.[/url]

notes.title: War of the Light Part II Is Now Available!
notes.content:
The war continues! Steam players can now make the jump into War of the Light Part II. Members automatically have access to the content as part of membership, and non-members can purchase the DLC Pack right here on Steam. What are you waiting for? Metropolis needs you!


Learn More About War of the Light Part II!

The fate of the entire Emotional Spectrum hangs in the balance of an uneasy alliance between Green Lantern Hal Jordan and Sinestro. Feeling love is endangered by this relentless war, Carol Ferris and the Star Sapphires have come to Earth to restore their own entity and to stop the strife…and all who get in their way.

Look for “Warriors of Light II” in your Mission Journal and head to Mogo’s Command Center (Heroes) or Ranx’s Command Center (Villains) from your HQ to begin your adventures in War of the Light Part II.

Combat Rating: 106

New Solo Content!
New solo content is available in the open world in the Downtown Metropolis Battlezone and in a new solo Challenge, Spark of Parallax!

• New Daily Solo Missions
o Heroes and Villains can both rejoin the war in Metropolis between the Lantern corps with daily solo missions. Complete 10 Daily Solo Missions to gain entry to a special solo instance!
o Combat Rating: 106
• Spark of Parallax Solo Challenge
o The Spark of Parallax must make it to the Central Power Battery on Qward! Heroes and Villains must work with Hal Jordan and Sinestro to ensure that the entity of fear is restored, and the Emotional Spectrum is on its way to recovery.
o Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Challenge under Tier 6 of the 1 Player Tab.
o Combat Rating: 106


New Two Player Content!
Players receive a new Duo – Spark of Ion!

• Spark of Ion Duo
o The Spark of Ion must make it to the Central Power Battery on Oa before it’s too late. Help Hal Jordan and Sinestro make sure the essence of the entity arrives safely!
o Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Duo under Tier 6 of the 2 Player Tab.
o Combat Rating: 106


New Four Player Content!
Players receive a new 4-player Operation and Alert!

• Zamaron Conversion Chamber (4-Player Alert)
o The Star Sapphires are abducting female members of the various Lantern Corps in order to force them to join their ranks. Track the missing Lanterns’ ring signatures and head to Zamaron for a rescue mission.
o Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Alert under Tier 6 of the 4 Player Tab.
o Combat Rating: 106
• Avarice Impurity (4-Player Operation, Hero Only)
o Hal Jordan traveled to Mogo in response to a distress signal, but there has been no word from him since he left! Get to Mogo and investigate.
o Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Operation under Tier 6 of the 4 Player Tab.
o Combat Rating: 106
• Rage Impurity (4-Player Operation, Villain Only)
o Sinestro traveled to Ranx in response to a distress signal, but there has been no word from him since he left! Get to Ranx and investigate.
o Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Operation under Tier 6 of the 4 Player Tab.
o Combat Rating: 106


New Eight Player Content!
Players receive a new 8-player Operation.

• Love and War (8-Player Operation)
o Sinestro and Hal Jordan must get Carol Ferris to join their alliance. However, the Star Sapphires have hidden the location of Zamaron and aren’t welcoming any visitors. Fortunately, Sinestro and Hal have a plan.
o Open your On Duty Menu and look for the new Operation under Tier 6 of the 8 Player Tab.
o Combat Rating: 107


New PvE Gear!
Players receive new suit sets and styles inspired by different Lantern Corps and the Manhunters, and new Mist-Enhanced weapons. All War of the Light Part II gear drops are un-attuned.

• Heroes receive the Shepherd of Adara style inspired by Saint Walker of the Blue Lantern Corps.
• Villains receive the Avatar of Ophidian style inspired by Larfleeze of the Orange Lantern.
• All male characters receive the Sector 3601 style inspired by the Manhunters.
• All female characters receive the Heart of the Predator style, inspired by Star Sapphires.


New Base Items!
Collect new base items by participating in War of the Light Part II content, some of which are inspired by Lantern Corps.


New Collections & Feats!
Earn new Collections and Feats awarding a total of six skill points by completing War of the Light Part II content. Collections award new styles and base items inspired by War of the Light Part II content.


New Character Select Background!
Players can now select Zamaron as their Character Select Background.

notes.title: SOE and ProSiebenSat.1 part ways; European PS2, DCUO and EQ2 accounts must soon be transferred
notes.content:
Back in April, SOE launched an All Access subscription service designed to unify membership across SOE's free-to-play games including Planetside 2, DC Universe Online and Everquest 2, as well as the upcoming Everquest Next, Landmark and H1Z1. In Europe, though, it's a less attractive offer. SOE's EU portfolio is more fragmented, as their existing games are managed and distributed by ProSiebenSat.1 Games.

That soon won't be the case. SOE and ProSiebenSat.1 have today announced that, going forward, all ProSiebenSat.1 accounts for SOE games must be migrated to Sony's service. For EU players of Planetside 2, DC Universe Online and Everquest 2, existing accounts must be transferred from July 1st in order to keep playing. In addition, SOE have removed their region lock, so new accounts can be created directly on their system.

"We constantly review community feedback via all channels and want to thank you for your ongoing dialog," write SOE and ProSiebenSat.1 in a joint statement. "On or about July 1, 2014, we will offer PSG players the opportunity to migrate their existing accounts to SOE account management, in order to continue playing SOE games. All earned status, characters and in-game coin will transfer with the account."

Payment details and personal information won't be transferred, and so will have to be re-entered on the new SOE version of transferred accounts. For those currently using both services, however, SOE say they are unable to merge the two accounts.

PSG account holders will have until September 28th to migrate their account.

notes.title: SOE launch unified All Access subscription
notes.content:
As reported earlier this year, SOE are today launching their revised All Access Pass. It's a unified service that, for $15 per month, gives subscribers "top-tier" membership across all SOE games. As part of the transfer, individual subscriptions are being dropped; meaning Planetside 1 is now free-to-play. Or will be, at least, once they finish their maintenance period.

Currently, the All Access membership covers EverQuest, EverQuest II, DC Universe Online, PlanetSide 2, Vanguard: Saga of Heroes, and will include EverQuest Next, Landmark and H1Z1 when they launch. There are caveats to that list, though, as revealed in SOE's lengthy FAQ.

"Your DC Universe Online and PlanetSide 2 accounts will remain with ProSiebenSat.1 Games and will not be transferred over," explains the FAQ. "You will not be able to start new characters in DCUO or PS2 on your SOE All Access account for these games." For players in the EU (including the UK), that's a big deal. PlanetSide 2 and DCUO are arguably SOE's biggest draws at least until the release of Everquest Next and Landmark. That they're not included for subscribers in ProSiebenSat.1's territory makes for a far less attractive package.

For more on the All Access Pass, head to SOE's subscription micro-site. At least, do when it's back online.

Upcoming storylines will be presented in three parts--a trilogy of DLC. Following Sons of Trigon is "War of the Light: Part 1," which will introduce the Blue Lantern Corp. notes.title: DC Universe Online producer will 'celebrate' moving away from PS3
notes.content:
Update: After publishing this story, SOE contacted us to clarify that PS3 support will continue, and that there are currently no plans to stop updating the PS3 version. The original story follows.

DC Universe Online executive producer Larry Liberty can't wait for players to transition from PS3 to PS4, saying his team will "celebrate" once they no longer have to support Sony's aging console.

Ultimately, the team is limited by PS3's capabilities. "People want everything you can imagine in the DC Universe, and that's a lot. There's over 4000 NPCs, there's an almost infinite amount of power combinations," Liberty told Shacknews. "I would certainly love to do more. We have to figure out continually how to fit in memory on effectively a 220MB system--that's how much system RAM we have on PS3. To make that work is going to be a challenge for us."

Unfortunately for Liberty and his team, the game's audience is largely comprised of PS3 players. The game's popularity on console is due to being "the first MMO on PS3" and "console-friendly," to boot. With most of the audience on PS3, SOE has no choice but to "keep servicing PS3 for a while."

Making a PS4 version of DCUO has some benefits for PS3 players, as there will be a slight boost in graphics even on Sony's current-gen system. "We are making some art changes that will benefit all platforms as a result of PS4 development. So, PS3 will look a bit better. But rally, it's going to benefit PS4 and PC most," Liberty said.

Of course, "it will happen at some point," Liberty said about no longer supporting the PS3 version of the game. "I do expect that eventually, PS4 to come out, and probably be more successful than PS3 was as a platform. It wouldn't surprise me if we do get a pretty quick migration, but we'll keep servicing PS3 for a while," he said.

DC Universe Online will be getting its eighth expansion pack later this year, in time for the launch of the PS4 version of the game. "The good news for PS3 players is you can move to PS4, keep your friends, play together," Liberty pointed out, hopeful that many players will switch to the next-gen.

Sons of Trigon will also include Celestial, DCUO's 11th Power, which will grant Blessing or Cursed abilities that center around healing. Donna Troy (the first Wonder Girl) and Cheetah will also be added to the PvP ranks.

The Sons of Trigon DLC is set to release this fall. Pricing has not been revealed, but it will be available for free to the game's Legendary members.
